author: Tadas Tamosauskas <tadastamo@gmail.com>
commit message:
Refactor collapse preferences to store both open and closed states.

If we want an element to be closed by default, in
the previous implementation we would not have been
able to store that state - if a user opened an
element it would remove it from the collapsed
elements array, but would not keep it open on the
consecutive load, because it would fall back to
the default collapsed state.

This change stores both open and closed states,
and uses a new storage key to store the states
to avoid breaking changes due to old storage.

The collapse preferences are now stored in the
localStorage as a JSON object, with the key being
the name of the element and the value being a boolean
indicating whether the element is collapsed or not.
